question:

.ABUSE : ASUBE :: BEGIN : BIGEN :: OTHER : ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] The logic followed here is, **ABUSE: ASUBE**
